annotation.title_clean: טיוטת הנחיית הרשות להגנת הפרטיות: תחולת הוראות חוק הגנת הפרטיות על מערכות בינה מלאכותית
annotation.title_en: Draft Guidance of the Privacy Protection Authority: Application of the Privacy Protection Law to Artificial Intelligence Systems
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Draft guidance (April 2025) from Israel's Privacy Protection Authority interpreting the Privacy Protection Law, including Amendment 13, for AI systems. It covers legal basis, informed consent, accountability, privacy impact assessments, privacy officers and database registration. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Privacy law applies to AI models that store or process personal information in training and deployment.
AI outputs such as inferences and predictions about individuals are personal information.
Informed consent and notice duties under sections 3 and 11 take on added importance for AI.
Privacy impact assessments and privacy officers are key accountability tools.
Database registration must state a clear purpose, distinguishing training from deployment.
